carpet.rule.stringDupe.name: String Dupe
carpet.rule.stringDupe.desc: Reintroduces the tripwire string duplication exploit (MC-129055 / MC-59471), which was patched by Mojang in 1.21.2+
carpet.rule.stringDupe.extra.0: Bypasses the break in TripWireBlock.updateSource and the is(TRIPWIRE) check in TripWireHookBlock.calculateState, restoring the legacy tripwire duplication behavior. Requires string (tripwire) and only takes effect in 1.21.2+ (where the exploit was patched).
carpet.rule.villagerNoPriceOnAttack.name: Villager No Price On Attack
carpet.rule.villagerNoPriceOnAttack.desc: Prevents villagers from increasing prices when attacked. Affects both the attacked villager and witnesses
carpet.rule.maxPlayerHealth.name: Max Player Health
carpet.rule.maxPlayerHealth.desc: Set the max health for all players. Requires re-entering world to take effect. Supports values 20~1000. Default: 20.
carpet.rule.maxPlayerHealth.extra.0: Modifies the base value of MAX_HEALTH attribute. Applied on player login/respawn.
carpet.rule.playerAttackDamage.name: Player Attack Damage
carpet.rule.playerAttackDamage.desc: Set the base attack damage for all players. Requires re-entering world to take effect. Supports any numeric value. Default: 2.0.
carpet.rule.playerAttackDamage.extra.0: Modifies the base value of ATTACK_DAMAGE attribute. Applied on player login/respawn.
carpet.rule.totemRecipe.name: Totem of Undying Recipe
carpet.rule.totemRecipe.desc: Enables crafting Totem of Undying in crafting table. Requires re-entering world to take effect. Recipe: Golden Carrot, Enchanted Golden Apple, Emerald, Gold Block
carpet.rule.totemRecipe.extra.0: Dynamically registers/unregisters recipes on resource reload. Requires /reload or re-enter world.
carpet.rule.stackableTotem.name: Stackable Totem of Undying
carpet.rule.stackableTotem.desc: Allows Totems of Undying to stack up to 64. Takes effect immediately, no re-join needed. Compatible with enchanting and renaming.
carpet.rule.stackableTotem.extra.0: Only modifies max stack size. Existing stacked items won't auto-split when rule is turned off. New items will use vanilla stacking.
carpet.rule.stackableLavaBucket.name: Stackable Lava Bucket
carpet.rule.stackableLavaBucket.desc: Allows Lava Buckets to stack up to 64. Takes effect immediately, no re-join needed. Still usable for placing lava.
carpet.rule.stackableLavaBucket.extra.0: Only modifies max stack size. Existing stacked items won't auto-split when rule is turned off.
carpet.rule.stackableGlassBottle.name: Stackable Glass Bottle
carpet.rule.stackableGlassBottle.desc: Allows glass bottles to stack up to 64. Takes effect immediately, no re-join needed. Still usable for water/brewing.
carpet.rule.stackableGlassBottle.extra.0: Only modifies max stack size. Existing stacked items won't auto-split when rule is turned off.
carpet.rule.stackableWaterBucket.name: Stackable Water Bucket
carpet.rule.stackableWaterBucket.desc: Allows water buckets to stack up to 64. Takes effect immediately, no re-join needed. Still usable for placing water.
carpet.rule.stackableWaterBucket.extra.0: Only modifies max stack size. Existing stacked items won't auto-split when rule is turned off.
carpet.rule.maxAir.name: Max Air Supply
carpet.rule.maxAir.desc: Set the max underwater air supply (in game ticks) for all players. Requires re-entering world to take effect. Default: 300 (15 seconds).
carpet.rule.maxAir.extra.0: Modifies LivingEntity.getMaxAirSupply() return value. Applied on player login/respawn. 20 game ticks = 1 second.
carpet.rule.hopperMinecartStackSize.name: Hopper Minecart Stack Size
carpet.rule.hopperMinecartStackSize.desc: Customize the max stack size for hopper minecarts (max 99). Takes effect immediately. Set to a value greater than 1 to enable stacking. Default: 1 (vanilla).
carpet.rule.hopperMinecartStackSize.extr: A numeric rule supporting values 1~99. For example, set to 99 to stack hopper minecarts to 99. Set to 1 to restore vanilla behavior.
carpet.rule.stackablePotion.name: Stackable Potion
carpet.rule.stackablePotion.desc: Allows all potions (regular/splash/lingering) to stack up to 64. Takes effect immediately, no re-join needed.
carpet.rule.stackablePotion.extra.0: Uses instanceof PotionItem check, covering all potion types. Potion effects are unaffected. Existing stacked potions won't auto-split when rule is turned off.
carpet.rule.stackableStew.name: Stackable Stew
carpet.rule.stackableStew.desc: Allows all stews (mushroom/rabbit/beetroot/suspicious) to stack up to 64. Takes effect immediately, no re-join needed.
carpet.rule.stackableStew.extra.0: Covers mushroom stew, rabbit stew, beetroot soup, and suspicious stew. Existing stacked stews won't auto-split when rule is turned off.
carpet.rule.stackableCake.name: Stackable Cake
carpet.rule.stackableCake.desc: Allows cakes to stack up to 64. Takes effect immediately, no re-join needed. Still placeable and edible.
carpet.rule.stackableCake.extra.0: Only modifies max stack size. Existing stacked cakes won't auto-split when rule is turned off.
carpet.rule.villagerGolem.name: Villager Golem
carpet.rule.villagerGolem.desc: Allows summoning a villager by placing a carved pumpkin on an emerald block, similar to snow golem construction. Takes effect immediately.
carpet.rule.villagerGolem.extra.0: Place a carved pumpkin on top of an emerald block to summon a villager. Both blocks are consumed. Disable the rule to prevent summoning.
carpet.rule.villagerAttraction.name: Villager Attraction
carpet.rule.villagerAttraction.desc: Villagers follow players holding specific items, like animals follow wheat. Takes effect immediately.
carpet.rule.villagerAttraction.extra.0: Emerald Block attracts all villagers; Emerald attracts unemployed villagers; Lapis Lazuli attracts employed villagers; Cake attracts baby villagers.
carpet.rule.fastLeafDecay.name: Fast Leaf Decay
carpet.rule.fastLeafDecay.desc: Leaves start decaying immediately after logs are removed, no tick delay. Takes effect immediately.
carpet.rule.fastLeafDecay.extra.0: Modifies the scheduled tick delay in LeavesBlock.updateShape to 0, so leaves enter the decay process instantly after losing support.
carpet.rule.fixedXpPerLevel.name: Fixed XP Per Level
carpet.rule.fixedXpPerLevel.desc: Requires a fixed 62 XP per level (same as vanilla level 20→21). Requires re-entering world to take effect.
carpet.rule.fixedXpPerLevel.extra.0: Modifies Player.getXpNeededForNextLevel() to always return 62. XP required per level no longer increases, suitable for custom servers.
carpet.rule.furnaceXpMultiplier.name: Furnace XP Multiplier
carpet.rule.furnaceXpMultiplier.desc: Multiplier for furnace smelting XP output. Takes effect immediately. Default: 1.0 (vanilla).
carpet.rule.furnaceXpMultiplier.extra.0: Multiplies the experience produced when taking items out of a furnace after smelting. E.g., 2.0 doubles XP, 0.5 halves, 0.0 gives no XP.
carpet.rule.tridentVoidReturn.name: Loyalty Trident Void Return
carpet.rule.tridentVoidReturn.desc: Loyalty-enchanted tridents automatically return when 10 blocks below the void. Takes effect immediately.
carpet.rule.tridentVoidReturn.extra.0: Works in all dimensions (Overworld, Nether, End). Triggers when the trident's Y is below world min height - 10.
carpet.rule.villagerReincarnation.name: Villager Reincarnation
carpet.rule.villagerReincarnation.desc: Villagers killed by an enchanted wooden sword drop a spawn egg with their trade data. Takes effect immediately.
The spawn egg preserves the villager's profession, level, trades, and XP. The spawned villager is identical except for reset health and will find a new workstation. Requires a wooden sword with any enchantment.
carpet.rule.bedrockSugarcaneBonemeal.des: Allows bone meal to be used on sugarcane to grow it instantly, like Bedrock Edition. Takes effect immediately.
carpet.rule.bedrockSugarcaneBonemeal.ext: Makes sugarcane accept bone meal and grow to maximum height, same as Bedrock behavior.
carpet.rule.bedrockPortalZombiePigman.de: Zombie pigmen have a chance to spawn when a nether portal is lit, like Bedrock Edition. Takes effect immediately.
carpet.rule.bedrockPortalZombiePigman.ex: When a nether portal is created, there is a chance for zombie pigmen to spawn around it, similar to Bedrock Edition behavior.
carpet.rule.bedrockPushableFurnace.name: Bedrock Pushable Furnace
carpet.rule.bedrockPushableFurnace.desc: Allows furnaces, smokers, and blast furnaces to be pushed by pistons, like Bedrock Edition. Takes effect immediately.
carpet.rule.bedrockPushableFurnace.extra: Overrides the default block entity push restriction to allow furnaces to be moved by pistons. Works for all furnace types.
carpet.rule.protectImmatureCrops.name: Protect Immature Crops
carpet.rule.protectImmatureCrops.desc: Prevents players from breaking immature crops (wheat, carrots, potatoes, beetroots). Takes effect immediately.
carpet.rule.protectImmatureCrops.extra.0: Checks crop growth stage before destroying. Only mature crops can be broken by players.
carpet.rule.observerTickDelay.name: Observer Tick Delay
carpet.rule.observerTickDelay.desc: Sets the observer's trigger delay in game ticks. Default 2gt (vanilla). Takes effect immediately.
carpet.rule.observerTickDelay.extra.0: Modifies the delay between detecting a block change and emitting a redstone signal. Set to 1 for faster response, higher values for longer pulses.
carpet.rule.disableSnow.name: Disable Snow
carpet.rule.disableSnow.desc: Prevents snow from accumulating naturally in cold biomes. Water freezing is unaffected. Takes effect immediately.
carpet.rule.disableSnow.extra.0: Only intercepts Biome.shouldSnow (snow layer accumulation), blocking snow accumulation; water freezing (shouldFreeze) keeps vanilla behavior. Manually placed snow and ice are unaffected.
carpet.rule.disableKelpGrowth.name: Disable Kelp Growth
carpet.rule.disableKelpGrowth.desc: Prevents kelp from growing naturally beyond its current height. Takes effect immediately.
carpet.rule.disableKelpGrowth.extra.0: Intercepts kelp's random tick growth, stopping upward natural extension. Does not affect existing kelp or manual placement/bonemeal.
carpet.rule.cactusGrowthMultiplier.name: Cactus Growth Multiplier
carpet.rule.cactusGrowthMultiplier.desc: Sets the random growth multiplier for cactus. Takes effect immediately.
carpet.rule.cactusGrowthMultiplier.extra: Multiplies the random tick growth chance and AGE increment rate. 2.0 = double growth chance; 16.0 = almost always grow one block per random tick. 1.0 = vanilla.
carpet.rule.cactusBoneMeal.name: Bonemeal Cactus
carpet.rule.cactusBoneMeal.desc: Allows using bone meal on cactus to force growth. Takes effect immediately.
carpet.rule.cactusBoneMeal.extra.0: Bone meal forces cactus to grow one block (ignoring AGE, like Bedrock Edition). Cannot grow when total height reaches 3.
carpet.rule.pickBlockNbt.name: Pick Block NBT Fix
carpet.rule.pickBlockNbt.desc: Fixes Ctrl+Middle Click not copying block NBT data (e.g. chest contents) in Creative mode for MC 26.2. Takes effect immediately.
carpet.rule.pickBlockNbt.extra.0: Forces includeData=true in handlePickItemFromBlock when player has infinite materials, restoring the vanilla behavior from 1.21.8/1.21.11.
carpet.rule.beaconUnifiedPPUpdate.name: Beacon Unified PP Update
carpet.rule.beaconUnifiedPPUpdate.desc: Every 20 game ticks, sends a unified block update to all beacons sitting directly on shallow-layer lapis ore (minecraft:lapis_ore). All qualifying beacons are updated at the same server-tick-end phase with consistent micro-timing.
Shallow lapis ore = the stone variant (lapis_ore), not deepslate_lapis_ore. Fire phase: the very start of the block-entity (TE) phase (Level.tickBlockEntities HEAD). Calls updateNeighbourShapes (PP update) on the beacon position, so neighboring blocks (including observers and redstone wire above) receive the update. All beacons are updated consecutively in coordinate order within the same phase for consistent micro-timing.
carpet.rule.noZombieHorseSpawn.name: No Zombie Horse Spawn
carpet.rule.noZombieHorseSpawn.desc: Prevents zombie horses from naturally spawning at night (as monsters). Takes effect immediately. [Only works on MC 26.2+; ineffective on 26.1/26.1.2]
carpet.rule.noZombieHorseSpawn.extra.0: Intercepts Monster.checkMonsterSpawnRules (the spawn pre-check registered for zombie horses), returning false when the spawn reason is NATURAL (night-time monster spawning) so the horse never enters the spawn flow. Does not affect spawn eggs, commands, or breeding. Note: only since 26.2 is ZombieHorse registered in SpawnPlacements with this pre-check; this rule has no effect on 26.1/26.1.2.
carpet.rule.anvilNoDamage.name: Anvil No Damage
carpet.rule.anvilNoDamage.desc: Anvils never degrade or break when used (vanilla has a 12% chance to damage per use). Takes effect immediately.
carpet.rule.anvilNoDamage.extra.0: Intercepts AnvilBlock.damage and returns the original state when enabled: intact/chipped/damaged anvils never degrade or disappear. Falling anvil breakage is unaffected.
carpet.rule.calciteRecipe.name: Calcite Recipe
carpet.rule.calciteRecipe.desc: Adds a crafting recipe for calcite: andesite + bone meal = 2 calcite. Requires /reload or re-entering world.
carpet.rule.calciteRecipe.extra.0: Shapeless, fully renewable materials (andesite = diorite + cobblestone; bone meal = skeletons/composter). 1:1 ratio, no dupe exploits.
carpet.rule.tuffRecipe.name: Tuff Recipe
carpet.rule.tuffRecipe.desc: Adds a crafting recipe for tuff: cobblestone + bone meal = 2 tuff. Requires /reload or re-entering world.
carpet.rule.tuffRecipe.extra.0: Shapeless, fully renewable materials (cobblestone = cobblestone generators; bone meal = skeletons/composter). Pairs with the calcite recipe: "stone variant + bone meal = cave stone".
carpet.rule.woolToString.name: Wool To String
carpet.rule.woolToString.desc: Adds a recipe to unravel wool: 1 wool (any color) = 4 string. Requires /reload or re-entering world.
carpet.rule.woolToString.extra.0: Uses the #minecraft:wool tag, all 17 colors supported. Perfectly reversible with the vanilla "4 string = 1 wool" recipe, no dupe exploits.
carpet.rule.quartzUnpack.name: Quartz Unpack
carpet.rule.quartzUnpack.desc: Adds a recipe to unpack quartz blocks: 1 quartz block = 4 nether quartz. Requires /reload or re-entering world.
carpet.rule.quartzUnpack.extra.0: Reversible with the vanilla "4 quartz = 1 quartz block". Only the plain quartz block is supported (pillar/chiseled/bricks are 1:1 recipes, unpacking them would dupe quartz).
carpet.rule.pearlChunkKeepalive.name: Pearl Chunk Keepalive
carpet.rule.pearlChunkKeepalive.desc: Fixes a vanilla bug: after quitting and re-entering the world, the chunk containing an airborne ender pearl sometimes stops loading, leaving the pearl frozen mid-air and unable to complete its teleport. When enabled, the pearl's chunk is force-loaded when entering the world so the pearl resumes normally.
carpet.rule.pearlChunkKeepalive.extra.0: Root cause (vanilla 1.21.5+): on rejoin only one 40gt ticket is placed, and renewal depends entirely on the chain "chunk loads -> pearl ticks -> ticket renews"; a chunk-system race can break the chain into a permanent deadlock (chunk unloads -> pearl never ticks -> never renews). This rule force-loads the pearl's chunk synchronously when it is spawned in (once per pearl, negligible cost), after which the vanilla mechanism resumes renewal on its own.
